ts.desc: Timestamp of the message to add unfurl behavior to.

unfurls.desc: URL-encoded JSON map with keys set to URLs featured in the the message, pointing to their unfurl blocks or message attachments.

user_auth_message.desc: Provide a simply-formatted string to send as an ephemeral message to the user as invitation to authenticate further and enable full unfurling behavior

user_auth_required.desc: Set to `true` or `1` to indicate the user must install your Slack app to trigger unfurls for this domain

user_auth_url.desc: Send users to this custom URL where they will complete authentication in your app to fully trigger unfurling. Value should be properly URL-encoded.

desc: Provide custom unfurl behavior for user-posted URLs
